detailed_descriptions_html.en:
STEEL GULLET is a physics-driven factory automation game about using the physical properties of materials to sort chaotic scrap streams and transform raw materials into complex industrial products.

Sort the Chaos

Scrap never arrives clean. Every stream is a random mix of materials, and there are no magic filters to fix it. You build separators from real machines and real physical properties, and design chains nobody has designed before.

Use Real Physics

Every material has temperature, density, conductivity, and melting and boiling points. Control them to control the stream:

  • Concrete block? Crush it.

  • Iron scrap? Grind it into dust and pull it out with a magnet.

  • Rubber tire? Melt it and drain it.

Turn Waste Into Products

Sorted materials are only the start. Process them into new forms and aggregate them into complex industrial products that fill your quotas.

Factory must grow

  • Build conveyor networks and optimize every chain

  • Research new machines

  • Buy new spaces and speed up production

  • Explore a big map with new resources and new problems R.S.T. struggle against the totalitarian G.R.I.D.
